description: Offers buyers have made on the seller's own listings, in PAYOUTS only: what the seller gets if they accept, what they get at their current price, the least a counter can pay them, and what any counter or agreed deal pays them. Never quote buyer prices to the seller. Buyers are shown by first name and last initial; their contact details are never available.

include_closed.description: Include accepted, declined and expired offers (default false: only ones still open).
